item: Subtab arrow keys follow a right-to-left strip (row 192)
summary: Found on the Arabic dossier walk: ooSubtabs mapped ArrowLeft to the previous tab in every direction, so in a right-to-left strip it moved the selection visually right. Left and right are now visual keys, read from the strip's computed direction (or the nearest dir attribute) at each key press; up, down, Home and End keep DOM order. Every ooSubtabs surface gains it. Also drops the dossier tab bar's dead nowrap and sideways-scroll rules (nav.tabs is more specific, so the bar always wrapped, which keeps every rail name in view). A node test drives the real component both ways and fails on the old code.
